en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand riverside building labeled as Café Kaiserpark, nestled in a forested valley. The structure features large arched windows in a long pavilion-like section with ornate domes along the roofline, attached to a taller, turreted historicist villa behind it. Trees frame the scene in the foreground and a river runs along the right side of the building. Printed title text appears in the upper right corner.
